scope.count_correction: The current checked-in collision audit files contain 151 data rows; 147 in issue #407 is superseded for this map.
scope.identity_registry_interpretation: No current permanent language-construction record directly identifies any of the eleven paired relations; neighboring parser and child identities do not settle relation identity.

interpretive_rules: ClauseRelationGraph, ClauseRelationEdge, and member-span nodes remain parser infrastructure and carry zero independent linguistic-evidence weight.
An identity signal means the reviewed relation is not preserved by a generic graph alone; it does not allocate a UUID, assign a short code, or change status.
Current runtime profiles are implementation evidence only and cannot establish productivity or identity.
Complete overt paired profiles must remain distinct from fragments, discourse continuations, homographs, and neighboring relation families.
